name: tt-Depth-Anything-3
description: Blackhole p150a port of the Depth Anything V3 metric-depth model (DA3Metric-Large, 0.35B parameters). The 24-block DINOv2-L backbone runs as one fused, traced device graph, with the DPT head on the host. Includes a benchmark, a served predict endpoint, and a KITTI Eigen accuracy harness that matches the canonical ByteDance model on all 697 images.
author: changh95
